name: dev.forgesworn/bray
description: Trust-aware Nostr for AI agents -- 253 tools covering validation, reconciliation, social, DMs, zaps, trust, and identity

environmentVariables.description: Nostr secret key (nsec, hex, or BIP-39 mnemonic)
environmentVariables.name: NOSTR_SECRET_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of Nostr relay WebSocket URLs
environmentVariables.name: NOSTR_RELAYS

environmentVariables.description: Path to a private 0600 file holding a Nostr Wallet Connect URI (NIP-44 v2 wallets only). Give that connection a budget in the wallet: it is the hard spending limit. Raw NWC_URI is refused
environmentVariables.name: NWC_URI_FILE

environmentVariables.description: bray's ceiling on any one payment, in millisatoshis (default 5000000)
environmentVariables.name: BRAY_MAX_PAYMENT_MSAT

environmentVariables.description: bray's ceiling on spending in any rolling 24 hours, in millisatoshis (default 20000000)
environmentVariables.name: BRAY_MAX_DAILY_MSAT
